verdict.rationale: Bolna offers call summaries, extraction categories, and analytics/call-history views that surface AI-derived data from calls (call_summary_enabled, extraction-categories API, analytics tab), but this is limited to per-call summarization/extraction rather than broader proactive insights or suggestions across aggregated data. missing for 10: evidence of cross-call/aggregate analytics dashboards, proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations beyond single-call summaries, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these features working in practice.
